readme:
# Flux 3 Image to Video

FLUX 3 image-to-video: 5–20 second clips with optional native audio at 720p or 1080p.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Text instruction. |
| `image` | image URL, required | — | First frame. JPEG, PNG, or WebP URL. |
| `resolution` | `720p` / `1080p` | `720p` | Sets the per-second rate. |
| `duration` | 5–20 | 5 | Output length in seconds. |
| `generate_audio` | boolean | true | Native audio. Same price on or off. |
| `aspect_ratio` | `21:9` / `2:1` / `16:9` / `4:3` / `1:1` / `3:4` / `9:16` | — | Output frame shape. |

## Billing

You pay for output seconds: $0.17 at 720p and $0.29 at 1080p.

| Output | 720p | 1080p |
|---|---|---|
| 5s (default) | $0.85 | $1.45 |
| 10s | $1.70 | $2.90 |
| 20s | $3.40 | $5.80 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Describe subject, action, camera, and sound.

## Limits

- Clips are 5–20 seconds.

## Also on SandBase

Other FLUX 3 endpoints: `bfl/flux-3/text-to-image`, `bfl/flux-3/edit`, `bfl/flux-3/text-to-video`.
